title: Greendale Fault surface displacement after the 2010 Canterbury earthquake
credit: Brendan Zim; Creative Commons Attribution 2.0 Generic, from Wikimedia Commons. WebP derivatives resized without cropping.
altText: Contemporaneous ground photograph of lateral surface displacement along the Greendale Fault caused by the September 2010 Canterbury earthquake.
caption: Brendan Zim photograph of ground rupture and displacement along the Greendale Fault on 4 September 2010. The physical damage shows the event measured and mapped by field teams.
context: A dated original photograph of the September 2010 earthquake's physical impact. The image does not show a response mapping application or prove a named agency's GIS use.
derivativesNote: Local original stored unchanged; WebP display width up to 1600 pixels and thumbnail width up to 720 pixels, resized without cropping.
